company.name: Electric
company.shortDescription: Electric provides an IT management platform with security, device management, employee onboarding, and business IT automation tools.
company.description: Electric is the industry leader in providing world-class IT technology and real-time support for small and mid-sized businesses. With close to 1,000 customers and more than 45,000 employee end-users, Electric's IT platform includes: real-time support powered by 100+ IT technicians, security, device & inventory management, network & server management, application & cloud management, employee on-boarding and off-boarding, procurement & provisioning, and data monitoring & insights.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,279,179 to $1,000,000,000, a 137.38x increase.
